description: Charter destinations sold on TUI.pl for a stay-length window, with per-person and total prices: filter by origin/destination airports and trip duration in days. Prices are charter seat prices in PLN. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_url, passengers, duration, count, destinations: [...] } — the list key is `destinations`. Each: { destination_name, airport_code, country, per_person_price, total_price, currency }. There are no per-flight times here; TUI only publishes a destination price.

departure_airports.description: Origin IATA codes to filter by, e.g. ['WAW']. Omit for all.

destination_airports.description: Destination IATA codes to filter by, e.g. ['AYT']. Omit for all.

duration_from.description: Minimum stay length in days. Default 6.

duration_to.description: Maximum stay length in days. Default 8.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

name: tui_search_charters
title: TUI charter destinations
